Instead of broadcasting generic resumes into automated tracking software, fellowship alumni access our dedicated <a href="/learners/jobs/">AI Jobs Board</a>. Partner startups and enterprise engineering managers review verified contribution logs directly, cutting through screening noise to extend interviews for high-compensation technical roles. For detailed industry compensation analysis across entry to senior roles, refer to our benchmark report on <a href="/blog/ai-agent-developer-salary-2026/">AI Agent Developer Salary Scales in India 2026</a>.</p><h2>The Evidence Wall: Verifiable Letters vs. Attendance Participation</h2><div class="disclosure"><p><strong>The Evaluation Standard:</strong> In current AI recruitment markets, unverified certificates of online attendance have zero predictive value for technical performance. An engineer is evaluated exclusively by their code output, error resolution habits, and architectural reasoning during live technical screenings.</p><p><strong>Independently Verifiable Credentials:</strong> To eliminate credential fraud and guarantee recruiter trust, every accomplishment within the DBERT ecosystem is cryptographically recorded. Hiring managers can enter any certificate ID directly into our global <a href="/verify/">Certificate Verification Engine</a> to audit explicit learning tracks, mentor signatures, and Git repository contributions without requiring third-party outreach.</p><p><strong>Transparent Fee Structures &amp; EMI:</strong> We maintain complete fiscal clarity across our learning tracks. Launchpad tuition is fixed at ₹7,999; Accelerate at ₹4,999; and Fellowship onboarding at ₹1,599 (covering dedicated mentor review hours and certificate issuance). Flexible EMI installment structures remain accessible across all learning tiers.</p></div></div></div></section><section class="subpage-section band-alt"><div class="wrap"><div class="section-head-sub"><div class="doclabel">§ 05 — SPECIALIZATION TRACKS &amp; FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-0" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Incoming requests.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="container pad-block"><div class="article"><h2>What a paid AI internship in India usually gets wrong</h2><p>Search for a paid AI internship in India and most of what comes back is a course with an internship label stapled to it. The work is a sandbox: a to-do app, a chatbot against a public API, a notebook that runs once and is never opened again. The certificate at the end certifies attendance. Recruiters have learned to read straight past it, which is why so many candidates with three internships on a CV still cannot answer a question about production incidents, migrations, or code review.</p><div class="card p-6 bg-card border border-line my-6"><div class="doclabel mb-2">THE HONEST COMPARISON</div><div class="space-y-3 font-mono text-sm"><div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-1 border-b border-line/50 pb-2"><span class="redline-del">Unpaid prompt engineering on toy notebooks</span><span class="text-ok font-semibold">→ Merged commits on live venture repos</span></div><div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-1 border-b border-line/50 pb-2"><span class="redline-del">Certificate of online video attendance</span><span class="text-ok font-semibold">→ Verifiable UUID credential on /verify</span></div><div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-1"><span class="redline-del">Paying ₹1.5L upfront with empty job guarantees</span><span class="text-ok font-semibold">→ Performance stipend up to ₹18,000</span></div></div></div><p>The gap is not knowledge. It is evidence. An engineer who has shipped to a repository with users on the other end has a different set of habits — they write migrations that can be rolled back, they read a stack trace before they read Stack Overflow, and they can explain why a pull request was rejected. Those habits are visible in an interview within about ten minutes, and no amount of coursework simulates them. For deeper strategic guidance on separating legitimate technical engagements from marketing sandboxes, review our <a href="/blog/paid-ai-internship-india-guide-2026/">2026 Guide to Paid AI Internships in India</a>.</p><h2>What the DBERT Fellowship actually is</h2><p>The fellowship is a three-month, selection-based programme that places you inside a development squad building software for DBERT&#x27;s own incubated startups and enterprise clients. It sits at the top of the<!-- --> <a href="/learners/">AI career programs</a> ladder, after<!-- --> <a href="/learners/accelerate/">the Accelerate engineering programme</a>, and it is the rung where the work stops being ours and starts being a client&#x27;s.</p><p>That distinction drives everything else about the programme. Because a client is waiting on the output, your pull requests are reviewed by senior engineers against the same bar as any other contributor&#x27;s, and rejected on the same grounds. Because the systems are live, the work is unglamorous in the specific way real work is unglamorous — schema changes, retrieval quality, error handling, the long tail of things that only matter when someone is actually using the software.</p><h3>The work itself</h3><p>Squads are assigned to a system rather than a curriculum, so the exact stack depends on the client. Across recent squads that has meant:</p><ul><li>REST and token-streaming API routes, including auth and rate limiting</li><li>Postgres schema design and migrations, plus vector-index configuration for retrieval</li><li>Retrieval-augmented generation pipelines — chunking, embedding, evaluation of answer quality</li><li>Front-end interfaces against those APIs, built to the client&#x27;s design</li><li>Deployment, environment configuration, and the observability needed to debug it later</li></ul><p>You will not touch all of it. Squads specialise, and a fellow who spends three months getting a retrieval pipeline genuinely good has a better story than one who touched everything shallowly. Explore how these production vector components come together in our technical workshop on <a href="/blog/rag-pipeline-tutorial-from-scratch/">Production RAG Architecture from Scratch</a>.</p><h3>Selection: two ways in</h3><p>The first route is completing<!-- --> <a href="/learners/accelerate/">DBERT Accelerate</a>, which is how most fellows arrive — by then we have seen months of their code and know what they can be trusted with. The second is the external code screening challenge, open to anyone regardless of where they learned. The screening exists so that self-taught engineers and graduates of other programmes are not locked out of the pipeline by not having bought our course first.</p><p>Either way, the application asks for code — a repository, a deployed project, a screening submission — rather than a list of coursework. That is what the decision is made on.</p><h3>The stipend, stated plainly</h3><p>The stipend ranges from <strong>₹5,000 to ₹18,000</strong> and is performance-based: it is paid against delivery milestones and code quality, not hours logged. Nobody starts at the top of the band. A fellow who ships reviewed, merged work across the full three months earns materially more than one who does not, and we would rather say that here than have you discover it in month two. To see how intermediate and advanced performance directly scales into full-time compensation across Indian technology hubs, inspect our analysis of <a href="/blog/ai-agent-developer-salary-2026/">2026 AI Developer Salaries in India</a>.</p><p>The programme fee is <strong>₹1,599</strong> for the three months, covering mentorship, code review, and certificate and letter issuance. Fees are reviewed each cohort, so treat that as the current figure rather than a permanent one.</p><h2>What you leave with</h2><p>Three things, in descending order of how much they matter in an interview:</p><ol><li><strong>Merged commits on a system with users.</strong> Public where the client permits it, describable in detail where they do not. This is the part that changes how the interview goes.</li><li><strong>An experience letter naming the engineer who reviewed your work</strong> and the system you contributed to — not a certificate of attendance. It carries a certificate ID a recruiter can check independently at<!-- --> <a href="/verify/">the DBERT certificate verification page</a> without contacting us. A letter nobody can verify is worth what it costs to print.</li><li><strong>Visibility to partner startups.</strong> They review fellow performance logs when hiring, and<!-- --> <a href="/learners/jobs/">the AI jobs board for verified builders</a> is restricted to people with that record.</li></ol><h2>What we do not claim</h2><div class="disclosure"><p><strong>We do not guarantee placement.</strong> Any programme in India promising a job at the end is either selecting so hard that the guarantee is meaningless or is going to disappoint someone. A referral is not an offer, and we will not describe it as one.</p><p><strong>We do not publish a placement percentage or an acceptance rate.</strong> We would rather publish nothing than publish a number we cannot substantiate to a prospective fellow who asks how it was calculated. When the cohort history is long enough to state honestly, it will appear on<!-- --> <a href="/learners/jobs/">the jobs page</a> with its method attached.</p><p><strong>We do not promise the top of the stipend band.</strong> It is performance-based and most fellows land in the middle of it.</p></div></div></div><div class="band-top"><div class="container-sm"><h2 class="subsection-title">How three months are structured</h2><div class="timeline-stepper"><div class="timeline-step-item"><div class="timeline-step-number">01</div><div class="timeline-step-content bento-card"><h3 class="StepTimeline-module__lWPx7G__stepTitle">Technical onboarding and squad assignment</h3><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">You are assigned to a development squad under an engineering mentor, given repository access, and set up locally against the real database schema. Week one is environment, codebase tour, and your first reviewed pull request.</p></div></div><div class="timeline-step-item"><div class="timeline-step-number">02</div><div class="timeline-step-content bento-card"><h3 class="StepTimeline-module__lWPx7G__stepTitle">Active contribution sprints</h3><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">You design interfaces, configure vector indexes, build API routes, and take part in code review — on the client repository, not a fork. Every pull request is reviewed and graded by a senior engineer before it merges.</p></div></div><div class="timeline-step-item"><div class="timeline-step-number">03</div><div class="timeline-step-content bento-card"><h3 class="StepTimeline-module__lWPx7G__stepTitle">Evaluation and career handoff</h3><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Final module hardening, then the paperwork that makes the work legible to a recruiter: an experience letter tied to a verifiable certificate ID, your performance-based stipend, and introductions where a partner startup is hiring.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="container pad-block"><div class="bento-grid-2 undefined"><div class="article"><h2>Why this is structured as a fellowship, not a course</h2><p>A course can be run at any scale — the marginal cost of one more student is close to zero. Client work cannot. Every fellow consumes senior engineering review time on a repository with a deadline, which is the scarcest thing DBERT has. That constraint is why the programme is selective, why squads are small, and why we cannot simply admit everyone who applies.</p><p>It is also why the stipend is performance-based rather than flat. The programme only works if fellows ship: a squad carrying someone who does not is a squad missing a client deadline.</p></div><div class="bento-card undefined"><h3>What makes the fellowship different</h3><ul><li><strong>Not sandbox toys</strong> — production databases and live API pipelines, on the client repository.</li><li><strong>Senior code review</strong> — every pull request reviewed and graded before it merges.</li><li><strong>Independently verifiable</strong> — the letter carries an ID a recruiter can check without asking us.</li><li><strong>Direct hiring visibility</strong> — partner startups read performance logs when they hire.</li></ul></div></div><div class="article"><section id="faq" class="faq-block" aria-labelledby="faq-heading"><script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Is the DBERT fellowship really a paid AI internship?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes, with a specific structure worth understanding before you apply. class="container page-head"><div class="doclabel">§ 01 — TECHNICAL INTERVIEW AUDIT <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div><h1 class="page-title">Land Your First AI Engineering Role</h1><p class="lede-wide">Build the technical skills, communication structures, and resume layouts needed to clear rigorous coding interviews and system audits.</p></div><div class="section-band"><div class="container"><h2 class="sr-only">Key Preparation Tracks</h2><div class="bento-grid-3"><div class="bento-card center"><span class="icon-chip"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-mic" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 19v3"></path><path d="M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2"></path><rect x="9" y="2" width="6" height="13" rx="3"></rect></svg></span><h3 class="accent-note">Mock Interviews</h3><p class="text-sm">1-on-1 mock panel sessions with senior developers focusing on live coding and database design.</p></div><div class="bento-card center"><span class="icon-chip"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-code" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m16 18 6-6-6-6"></path><path d="m8 6-6 6 6 6"></path></svg></span><h3 class="accent-note">Live Coding Drills</h3><p class="text-sm">Real time algorithm evaluations addressing REST APIs, Python memory limits, and logic parsing.</p></div><div class="bento-card center"><span class="icon-chip"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-award" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m15.477 12.89 1.515 8.526a.5.5 0 0 1-.81.47l-3.58-2.687a1 1 0 0 0-1.197 0l-3.586 2.686a.5.5 0 0 1-.81-.469l1.514-8.526"></path><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="6"></circle></svg></span><h3 class="accent-note">Portfolio Reviews</h3><p class="text-sm">Exhaustive code audits of your active GitHub projects, README documentation, and system architecture.</p></div></div></div></div><div class="container pad-block"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 02 — HIRING PIPELINE STRATEGY</div><div class="bento-grid-2"><div class="stack"><h2 class="section-title">Crack the AI Engineering Hiring Pipeline</h2><p class="prose-lg">Getting hired as an AI developer or data analyst requires more than just listing projects on a resume. Tech recruiters look for candidates who can explain vector space dimensionality, write optimized database queries, solve complex coding tasks, and design scalable system architectures under pressure. A generic software resume will often be rejected by automated scanner algorithms before a human ever reviews it.</p></div><div class="bento-card undefined"><h3>Resume &amp; GitHub Optimization</h3><ul><li><strong>Keyword alignment</strong>: Target exact terms (e.g. pgvector, CrewAI, token caching) to pass automated ATS filters.</li><li><strong>Commit history curation</strong>: Structure repo README files, flow charts, and clean configurations.</li><li><strong>Outcome framing</strong>: Quantify project descriptions focusing on execution speeds and compute optimizations.</li></ul></div></div></div><div class="band-top"><div class="container-sm"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 03 — CAREER ACCELERATION ROADMAP</div><h2 class="subsection-title">Your Career Acceleration Roadmap</h2><div class="timeline-stepper"><div class="timeline-step-item"><div class="timeline-step-number">01</div><div class="timeline-step-content bento-card"><h3 class="StepTimeline-module__lWPx7G__stepTitle">1-on-1 Mock Technical Audits</h3><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Schedule mock technical panels with industry practitioners. Get real time feedback on coding efficiency, system design concepts, and database query optimizations.</p></div></div><div class="timeline-step-item"><div class="timeline-step-number">02</div><div class="timeline-step-content bento-card"><h3 class="StepTimeline-module__lWPx7G__stepTitle">GitHub &amp; Resume Scoring</h3><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Ensure your repositories, README documentation, LinkedIn profiles, and resumes highlight the correct keywords and project outcomes that AI recruiters query.</p></div></div><div class="timeline-step-item"><div class="timeline-step-number">03</div><div class="timeline-step-content bento-card"><h3 class="StepTimeline-module__lWPx7G__stepTitle">System Design Question Banks</h3><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Access curated question registers covering AI agent coordination patterns, vector indexing rules, and API token-streaming caching schemas.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="container pad-block"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 04 — INITIALIZE CAREER SUPPORT</div><div class="bento-card callout-plain"><h2 class="card-title">Get Interview-Ready and Get Hired</h2><p class="page-lede">Get direct feedback from industry mentors and optimize your public code profiles. Access DBERT Career Services.</p><a href="/learners" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg">Explore Career Tracks</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. class="mb-0">Privacy Policy</h1><span class="handnote blue" aria-hidden="true">statutory MSME framework ✍</span></div><p class="page-intro">How Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology (DBERT) protects, isolates, and secures developer, student, and startup partner data.</p></div><div class="stack gap-6"><div class="card card-lift"><span class="doclabel text-xs mb-1">§ 01 — SCOPE &amp; IDENTITY</span><h2 class="card-title my-2">Registered Entity Overview</h2><p class="body-copy">At DBERT (Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology, registered MSME entity UDYAM-UP-28-0105315), we prioritize data privacy and operational security across our website (<code>dbert.in</code>), learning platforms, and verification registries.</p></div><div class="card card-lift"><span class="doclabel text-xs mb-1">§ 02 — DATA INGESTION</span><h2 class="card-title my-2">1. Information We Collect</h2><p class="body-copy">We gather information strictly necessary to coordinate startup incubation tracks and engineering programs. This includes startup registration details (names, descriptions, stack outlines), learner applications (emails, names, GitHub repositories, and contact parameters), and details submitted via research collaboration forms.</p></div><div class="card card-lift"><span class="doclabel text-xs mb-1">§ 03 — COOKIES &amp; THIRD-PARTY ADVERTISING</span><h2 class="card-title my-2">2. Cookies, Google AdSense &amp; Analytics Disclosure</h2><p class="body-copy mb-3">We and our trusted third-party partners (such as Google AdSense, Google Analytics 4) use cookies, web beacons, and similar tracking technologies to analyze site traffic, personalize content, and serve relevant advertisements based on prior visits to this website or other sites on the Internet.</p><ul class="list-disc pl-5 space-y-2 text-sm text-zinc-300"><li><strong>Google AdSense &amp; DoubleClick Cookie:</strong> Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve ads on <code>dbert.in</code>. Google&#x27;s use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visits to our site and/or other sites on the Internet.</li><li><strong>User Opt-Out:</strong> Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting <a href="https://www.google.com/settings/ads" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-accent underline">Google Ads Settings</a>. Alternatively, you may opt out of third-party vendor cookies for personalized advertising by visiting <a href="https://www.aboutads.info" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-accent underline">aboutads.info</a>.</li><li><strong>Log Files &amp; Telemetry:</strong> Like most standard website servers, we utilize log files and anonymized telemetry (browser type, referring/exit pages, platform type, date/time stamp, and analytical click counts) to administer the portal and monitor platform health.</li></ul></div><div class="card card-lift"><span class="doclabel text-xs mb-1">§ 04 — USE OF INFORMATION</span><h2 class="card-title my-2">3. How We Use Information</h2><p class="body-copy">Your data is utilized solely to deliver services, evaluate startup registrations, coordinate mentor feedback, verify credentials, and process transaction milestones. We do not exchange, rent, or distribute candidate files or startup codebases to external commercial networks without explicit consent.</p></div><div class="card card-lift"><span class="doclabel text-xs mb-1">§ 05 — SECURITY &amp; ISOLATION</span><h2 class="card-title my-2">4. Data Sovereignty and Security</h2><p class="body-copy">We implement industry-standard encryption controls. Custom model weights, embeddings, or database queries run in private cloud virtual networks (VPCs) with zero-trust network boundaries, maintaining strict data isolation.</p></div><div class="card card-lift"><span class="doclabel text-xs mb-1">§ 06 — UPDATES &amp; AUDITS</span><h2 class="card-title my-2">5. Changes to This Policy</h2><p class="body-copy">We periodically update our policies to align with evolving statutory guidelines. mb-4">Frequently Asked Investor Questions</h2><div class="measure"><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqList"><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-0"><span>How does DBERT Labs technical due diligence differ from traditional angel venture screening?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-0" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Traditional angel syndicates and venture capital associates evaluate startups based almost entirely on pitch slide decks, subjective TAM forecasts, and founder rhetoric. Because DBERT Labs operates an active software laboratory and venture studio, our evaluation is fundamentally deterministic and architectural. We code-audit every portfolio founder’s actual Git repository, test their database RAG semantic indexing speeds, verify their Docker container scalability, and assess real computing unit economics before ever presenting deal flow to our network.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-1"><span>What is the corporate fee structure for accredited investors and VCs to access DBERT deal flow?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-1" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Joining the DBERT Investor Network is completely fee-free for verified accredited angel investors, seed syndicates, and institutional venture capital partners. We do not charge subscription management retainers or introductory broker surcharges to inspect deal flow. Our economic alignment derives directly from holding equity stakes (2% to 8%) in the portfolio companies we technically co-develop, ensuring our incentives are identical to incoming coinvestors.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>How does DBERT studio co-development eliminate early execution failure risk for seed investors?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Statistical failure across pre-seed software startups occurs primarily when non-technical founders expend their cash seed capital contracting mediocre external outsourcing agencies—resulting in architectural collapse, security breaches, or exhausted operating runways before launching an MVP. DBERT eradicates execution risk by deploying our in-house senior full-stack AI engineering squads directly into portfolio ventures under a dilution-free services-against-equity exchange, guaranteeing carrier-grade MVP deployment within a 90-day sprint.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>At what valuation stages and funding milestones do investors receive portfolio introductions?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We introduce portfolio founders to our investor network at two strategic inflection points: immediately upon achieving verified production technical launch (Pre-Seed/Angel rounds seeking ₹25,00,000 to ₹1,00,00,000 in early expansion capital) and post-revenue scaling milestones (Seed/Series A expansion rounds). Network investors receive exclusive proprietary access to founders before public fundraising rounds commence.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-4"><span>Can institutional venture capital funds refer their non-technical portfolio companies into DBERT Incubation?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-4" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Yes. Active VC partners frequently refer early-stage portfolio investments suffering from computational scaling bottlenecks or hiring delays directly into our venture studio. We perform technical intervention sprints, migrate public cloud API chat wrappers to cost-optimized bare-metal RunPod hardware, and stand up proprietary local open-weights inference engines.</p></div></div></div></div></section><section class="mb-12 pt-8 border-t border-line"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 07 — RELATED STUDIO DIVISIONS &amp; LEGAL FRAMEWORKS</div><h2 class="text-2xl font-mono font-bold text-white mb-4">Explore Definitive Venture Resources</h2><div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3"><div class="card p-4 bg-card border border-line"><h3 class="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-white mb-1">Services-Against-Equity Track</h3><p class="text-xs text-muted mb-3">Review how we invest senior software engineering squads in exchange for milestone corporate equity.</p><a class="accent-link text-xs" href="/startups/services/equity/">Explore Equity Model →</a></div><div class="card p-4 bg-card border border-line"><h3 class="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-white mb-1">Compute Funding &amp; MegaMenu-module__8k9CWa__drawerHandnote">handmade in Delhi ✍</span></div></div></div></div><main id="main-content" class="app-main"><div><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__hero"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__heroGrid"><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__logoRow"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__logoFrame"><img alt="Alkame Inc. Logo" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__logoImg" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;color:transparent" src="/alkame.png"/></div><div class="doclabel">§ 01 — FINTECH CASE STUDY <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div></div><h1 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__heroTitle">Alkame Inc.</h1><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__heroLede">Calibrated, conformal-prediction market intelligence across the NIFTY 500 — an applied research program DBERT incubates in exchange for equity.</p><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__btnRow"><a href="https://alkameinc.info/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm">Visit Alkame ↗</a><a href="https://github.com/Alkameinc/alkame-nifty-50-educational/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm">View GitHub Repo ↗</a></div></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__facts"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factsLabel">At a Glance</p><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factsList"><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">₹1.2Cr</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">Research contribution — DBERT services delivered in exchange for equity</p></div><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">4 Months</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">May – August 2026 applied research program</p></div><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">6,300+ Stocks</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">NIFTY 500 universe, sub-100ms ingestion latency</p></div></div></div></div></div><h2 class="sr-only">Research Methodology &amp; System Architecture</h2><div class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__bar"><div class="container AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__row"><span class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__label">Jump to:</span><a href="#research-question" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__linkActive">Research Question</a><a href="#architecture" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Architecture</a><a href="#challenges" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Challenges</a><a href="#timeline" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Timeline</a><a href="#team" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Team</a></div></div><div id="research-question" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">01</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->01<!-- --> — <!-- -->THE RESEARCH QUESTION</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Why Calibrated Confidence Matters</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">A documented gap between unregulated retail-facing signals and validated confidence — grounded in SEBI’s own regulatory data.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stack3"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__statGrid"><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">+41%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">YoY rise in aggregate retail derivative losses — ₹1,05,603cr in FY25</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~91%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">of individual traders ended FY25 in loss, averaging ~₹1.1 lakh each</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~20%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">YoY decline in unique traders even as losses rose — a structural, not cyclical, pattern</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~2%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">of financial “finfluencers” are SEBI-registered, yet 82% of investors act on their advice anyway</p></div></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__source">Sources: SEBI, Jul 2025; CFA Institute, 2025.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__question">Alkame-Nifty50 tests one falsifiable question: does enforcing calibrated confidence as a display gate — via split conformal prediction — and walk-forward, cost-aware validation as a promotion gate, produce lower calibration error and comparable-or-better risk-adjusted edge than Microsoft’s Qlib and a naive rule-based baseline?</p><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__accentCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__disclaimer">This is a pre-registered study design. No empirical results are claimed here — the research team has committed in advance to report the outcome whichever direction it points.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="positioning" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">02</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->02<!-- --> — <!-- -->GROUNDED IN RESEARCH</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Where This Sits vs. Existing Work</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Alkame-Nifty50’s contribution is architectural and applied, not a new algorithm — it integrates findings that, on their own, stop short of a production system.</p></div><div><div class="forms-module__s9hc7W__stack2"><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Kaya &amp; Nguyen (2025)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Conformal prediction achieves error rates tracking nominal significance levels, on 764 US large/mid-cap stocks, Jan 2022–Jan 2024.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>Small-scale, US-only proof of concept — not India-specific, not integrated into a production pipeline with drift detection.</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Bailey et al. (2014)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Formal proof that backtest overfitting is a near-inevitable statistical artifact of testing many configurations.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>Diagnoses the problem rigorously, but is a methodology paper — no live architecture for continuously re-validating deployed models.</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Gama et al. (2014)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Establishes the standard taxonomy of concept drift (sudden, gradual, incremental, recurring) in ML broadly.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>General-purpose survey, not applied to retail financial signal generation or tied to audit/regulatory requirements.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="architecture" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">03</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->03<!-- --> — <!-- -->SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">How Alkame-Nifty50 Is Built</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Four layers, each built to resist a specific, documented failure mode in retail-facing quantitative trading tools.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarGrid"><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Model Layer</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Per-symbol, per-horizon ensembles — logistic regression, random forest, gradient-boosted trees, and a stacking combiner — trained under strict no-lookahead discipline.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Calibration Layer</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Split conformal prediction sits on top of every model output. A prediction is only surfaced once its prediction set collapses to a single label — a distribution-free coverage guarantee, not a raw softmax score.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Drift Detection &amp; Retraining</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Every prediction — shown or withheld — is logged with a resolvable outcome. A retrained model must re-clear the same validation gates before replacing production, never auto-promoted.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Validation Gate</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Walk-forward backtesting across multiple non-overlapping windows, with explicit transaction-cost and slippage modeling, gates any promotion.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="challenges" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">04</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->04<!-- --> — <!-- -->ENGINEERING CHALLENGES</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Technical Difficulties &amp; How We Approached Them</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Five specific, well-documented failure modes shaped this design — each paired with the concrete choice made to address it, and the research it draws on.</p></div><div><div class="forms-module__s9hc7W__stack2"><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Most retail-facing prediction tools report a point prediction with no validated measure of confidence.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Split conformal prediction as a display gate — a call is only shown once its prediction set collapses to a single label, chosen over Platt scaling or isotonic regression for its distribution-free coverage guarantee.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Kaya &amp; Nguyen, 2025</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>A single attractive backtest is a well-documented statistical trap — testing many configurations can make a strategy look strong purely by chance.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Every candidate model clears a walk-forward, multi-window, cost-and-slippage-aware validation gate before promotion. One good backtest is necessary, never sufficient.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Bailey, Borwein, López de Prado &amp; Zhu, 2014</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Live markets drift, so a model validated last quarter can silently decay without anyone noticing.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>A Prediction Ledger logs every prediction against its eventual resolved outcome. Sustained degradation triggers retraining — the retrained model re-clears the same gates, no shortcuts.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Gama et al., 2014</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Comparing a new architecture fairly against existing tooling, rather than a strawman.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>The evaluation protocol benchmarks against Qlib — Microsoft’s open-source quant research platform — on identical data and time windows, plus a naive rule-based floor.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Yang, Liu, Zhou, Bian &amp; Liu, 2020</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>India’s regulatory footing for algorithmic and &quot;black box&quot; signal providers changed materially in 2025.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Scope is deliberately restricted to signal-quality assessment, not automated order execution — staying on the lower-friction research/signal side of SEBI’s new principal-agent framework.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">SEBI, Feb 2025</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="regulatory" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">05</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->05<!-- --> — <!-- -->COMPLIANCE BY DESIGN</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Built Against a Moving Regulatory Target</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">SEBI’s February 2025 circular introduced India’s first governance framework for retail algo trading — this changes how a system like Alkame must be classified.</p></div><div><div class="card"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBody alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBodySpaced">Under SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000013 (Feb 2025), stockbrokers are the <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">principal</span>, and any algo provider acts as their<!-- --> <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">agent</span>. Algorithms are classified as disclosed or<!-- --> <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">undisclosed (“black box”)</span> — Alkame’s ML ensemble falls in the latter category by construction.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBody">The project stays on the research/signal side of this line rather than automated execution — the compliance layer hard-blocks any output that reads as personalized advice or unauthorized order placement, avoiding the higher-friction execution regulatory bracket.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite alkame-module__kSbqrG__citeSpaced">SEBI, Feb 2025</p></div></div></div></div></div><div id="timeline" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">06</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->06<!-- --> — <!-- -->RESEARCH TIMELINE</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">A 4-Month Applied Research Program</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">May through August 2026, moving from infrastructure and model-building through live validation and drift monitoring.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timeline"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineRail"></div><div class="stack"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">MAY 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Data infrastructure and feature-store setup across NIFTY 500 constituents; no-lookahead discipline established.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">JUNE 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Model ensembles and the conformal calibration layer built out; Qlib and naive baselines prepared for matched comparison.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">JULY 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Walk-forward validation protocol executed; Prediction Ledger begins logging live, resolvable outcomes.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">AUGUST 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Live drift-monitoring window and program wrap-up; class="card-title">The Challenge</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Cognitive Solutions aimed to establish a scalable talent acquisition model to support their growing client integrations across Robotics, IoT, and AI agent frameworks. Their internal training infrastructure was unable to keep pace with client project onboarding, leading to resource delays and bottlenecks in their hardware-software integration pipeline.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT engineered a shared training framework and custom recruitment pathway. We synchronized Cognitive Solutions&#x27; stack parameters (ROS, Python automation, and device communication protocols) with our advanced learner curricula. We then established a targeted placement channel that pre-vetted interns through live simulation reviews before deployment.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">The collaborative pipeline successfully trained and placed qualified junior developers directly into live AI, IoT, and robotics integration projects. Technical onboarding time was reduced by 60%, allowing Cognitive Solutions to meet all client deployment schedules.</p></section><section class="card CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsCard"><h2 class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsTitle">Key Metrics</h2><p class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsValue">60% Reduction in Onboarding | 100% Client Deployment Compliance</p></section><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__foot"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/startups/register/">Get Similar Support for Your Startup</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. To sustain this expansion, they required a steady pipeline of skilled developers capable of maintaining student platforms and co-developing curriculum sandbox environments.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT incubated their growth model, establishing direct pipelines to our upskilled student network. We deployed interns specializing in full-stack Next.js interfaces, automated grading systems, and database configurations. Additionally, DBERT&#x27;s technical mentors reviewed and optimized their core learning management portal.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Digital Blaize successfully scaled its curriculum delivery across 6 technical domains. Website (<!-- -->gayatridevi.ai<!-- -->) ↗</a></p></div><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__body"><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Challenge</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Gayatri AI sought to establish open-source educational frameworks capable of deploying localized, low-resource AI agent nodes in classroom environments. They faced significant hurdles in optimizing model weight parameters for standard school CPUs and structuring clear API wrappers for students learning AI concepts in public registries.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT Labs spearheaded the open-source collaboration, delegating technical researchers and developers to commit directly to their repository. We designed modular multi-agent orchestration libraries, configured automated validation setups to review student-submitted prompts, and optimized local model pipelines utilizing Ollama integrations.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">The collaborative open-source partnership successfully published the Gayatri-AI framework. The libraries now support lightweight, offline-first multi-agent systems, enabling school environments to run interactive AI agent demonstrations on existing lab computers with sub-2s generation latency.</p></section><section class="card CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsCard"><h2 class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsTitle">Key Metrics</h2><p class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsValue">10+ Schools Deployed | ₹0 API Costs | Open Source</p></section><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__foot"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/startups/register/">Get Similar Support for Your Startup</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. They do not constitute formal binding legal advice. Startup founders must independently consult qualified Indian corporate legal counsel before formally incorporating agreements or legally modifying share capital tables under the Companies Act (2013).</p></div><section class="mb-lg"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 02 — CO-DEVELOPMENT EQUITY TIERS</div><h2 class="section-title mb-3">The 2% – 8% Standardized Co-Development Model</h2><p class="prose-lg mb-4 text-muted">Our advisory equity engagements are explicitly categorized into three rigid structural tiers based directly upon engineering labor volume, compute infrastructure complexity, and dedicated sprint team duration. Every level utilizes standardized Founder Advisor Standard Template (FAST) or sweat equity shareholder structures designed to integrate without friction into subsequent institutional fundraising due diligence.</p><div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 my-6"><div class="card p-5 bg-card border border-line flex flex-col justify-between"><div><span class="font-mono text-xs text-accent uppercase tracking-wider">Tier 1 · Advisory Level</span><h3 class="card-heading-lg mt-1 mb-2 text-white">2% – 3% Advisory Equity</h3><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed mb-4">Targeted at technical founders who possess active internal code execution squads but require experienced senior enterprise systems architecture oversite to avoid scaling bottlenecks and infrastructure security misconfigurations.</p><ul class="list-disc pl-4 text-xs text-muted space-y-1"><li>Weekly architectural codebase pull-request reviews</li><li>Vector database indexing &amp; RAG schema optimization</li><li>Direct access to our audited <a class="ink-link" href="/startups/services/hiring/">1,500+ developer hiring pool</a></li><li>Official Udyam/MSME corporate technical audits</li></ul></div><div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-line text-right font-mono text-xs text-muted">Vesting: 2-Year (6-Month Cliff)</div></div><div class="card p-5 bg-card border-2 border-accent flex flex-col justify-between relative"><div class="absolute -top-3 right-4 bg-accent text-zinc-950 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded">Most Deployed</div><div><span class="font-mono text-xs text-accent uppercase tracking-wider">Tier 2 · Co-Development</span><h3 class="card-heading-lg mt-1 mb-2 text-white">4% – 5% Sprint Equity</h3><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed mb-4">Designed for pre-seed founders and domain experts who need complete zero-to-production execution of their initial minimum viable commercial AI product without spending capital on external software development agency invoices.</p><ul class="list-disc pl-4 text-xs text-muted space-y-1"><li><strong>4 to 8 week agile code engineering sprints</strong></li><li>Dedicated full-stack React/Next.js UI/UX production</li><li>Containerized MLOps server orchestration setup</li><li>Non-dilutive cloud compute seed grant eligibility</li></ul></div><div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-line text-right font-mono text-xs text-muted">Vesting: Milestone-Gated Tranches</div></div><div class="card p-5 bg-card border border-line flex flex-col justify-between"><div><span class="font-mono text-xs text-accent uppercase tracking-wider">Tier 3 · Venture Partner</span><h3 class="card-heading-lg mt-1 mb-2 text-white">6% – 8% Venture Equity</h3><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed mb-4">A deeply integrated structural co-founding partnership. DBERT embeds an elite, specialized applied engineering squad managed directly by senior technical leadership to operate as your acting external AI technology organization.</p><ul class="list-disc pl-4 text-xs text-muted space-y-1"><li>Dedicated engineering squad (Applied AI Fellowship leads)</li><li>Custom LLM parameter fine-tuning on domain data</li><li>Continuous ongoing operational SLAs &amp; DevOps</li><li>Direct institutional angel investor introductions</li></ul></div><div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-line text-right font-mono text-xs text-muted">Vesting: 3-Year Strategic Alignment</div></div></div></section><section class="mb-lg"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 03 — ANNOTATED LEGAL CLAUSE BOOK</div><h2 class="section-title mb-3">Critical Structural Term Sheet Clauses Explained</h2><p class="prose-sm text-muted mb-6">Traditional venture studio covenants frequently obscure restrictive clauses within complex legal legalese. Below, we publish our core architectural clauses complete with explicit translation notes explaining why each term exists and how it actively safeguards founder rights.</p><div class="space-y-6"><div class="p-5 bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-lg border border-line"><div class="flex justify-between align-start mb-2"><h3 class="font-mono text-sm text-white font-bold">Clause 1: Milestone-Gated IP &amp; Code Assignment</h3><span class="badge badge-accent font-mono text-xs">Founder Protection</span></div><p class="font-mono text-xs text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-950 p-3 rounded border border-zinc-800 mb-3 leading-relaxed">&quot;All intellectual property, proprietary source code commits, custom model weight embeddings, and algorithmic documentation authored by DBERT technical squads under this agreement shall be automatically, irrevocably, and exclusively assigned to the Startup corporate entity immediately upon validation and integration of each designated sprint milestone deliverable into the official main source control branch.&quot;</p><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed"><strong>Why we structure it this way:</strong> Most traditional software agencies withhold intellectual property ownership until full financial completion invoices are settled. In an equity co-development relationship, you must hold unimpeded legal ownership over your source code at every progressive stage of growth to satisfy external investor legal due diligence and maintain technical self-reliance.</p></div><div class="p-5 bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-lg border border-line"><div class="flex justify-between align-start mb-2"><h3 class="font-mono text-sm text-white font-bold">Clause 2: Anti-Clawback &amp; Shared Execution Risk</h3><span class="badge badge-emerald font-mono text-xs">Zero Financial Risk</span></div><p class="font-mono text-xs text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-950 p-3 rounded border border-zinc-800 mb-3 leading-relaxed">&quot;In the event that the Startup commercial venture is formally concluded, restructured, or commercially unsuccessful prior to the realization of a liquidity event or public offering, DBERT expressly waives any right, option, or claim to financial recovery, retrospective labor fee conversion, or cash reimbursement for engineering development sprints rendered.&quot;</p><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed"><strong>Why we structure it this way:</strong> Building innovative artificial intelligence software carries inherent algorithmic and commercial adoption risks. When we sign an incubation term sheet, we step onto your cap table as authentic co-builders—we consciously assume execution risk alongside you rather than functioning as speculative debt collectors.</p></div><div class="p-5 bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-lg border border-line"><div class="flex justify-between align-start mb-2"><h3 class="font-mono text-sm text-white font-bold">Clause 3: Non-Interfering Governance &amp; Pro-Rata Dilution</h3><span class="badge badge-blue font-mono text-xs">Cap Table Cleanliness</span></div><p class="font-mono text-xs text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-950 p-3 rounded border border-zinc-800 mb-3 leading-relaxed">&quot;Advisory Shares issued under this agreement shall constitute standard voting or non-voting common stock equivalents carrying zero blocking rights, veto authority, or preferred operational governance mandates over executive corporate decision-making. Upon the execution of subsequent priced financing rounds, DBERT equity shall subject itself to proportional pro-rata dilution identical to founding common shareholders.&quot;</p><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed"><strong>Why we structure it this way:</strong> Institutional venture capital investors intensely dislike bloated early advisory covenants that attempt to preserve unrealistic anti-dilution ratchets or disruptive operational board voting vetoes. Our framework ensures your cap table remains perfectly clean, streamlined, and highly attractive for subsequent Series A lead term sheet negotiations.</p></div></div></section><section class="card undefined mb-lg bg-zinc-900 border-2 border-line p-6 text-center"><div class="doclabel mb-1">§ 04 — OPEN REFERENCE RESOURCE</div><h3 class="card-title text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">Download Standard India FAST Term Sheet (.PDF)</h3><p class="undefined text-sm text-muted max-w-xl mx-auto mb-6">Access our open-source, non-binding reference template containing explicit vesting schedules (2-year vesting with a standard 6-month cliff), IP assignment schedules, and statutory corporate Indian definitions.</p><div class="stack-h justify-center gap-4 flex-wrap"><a class="btn btn-primary undefined stack-h align-center gap-2" href="/startups/services/equity/"><svg width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" Online</a><a class="btn btn-outline" href="/blog/equity-for-services/">Read Equity Engineering Deep-Dive →</a></div></section><section class="mb-lg"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 05 — LEGAL KNOWLEDGE BASE</div><h2 class="section-title mb-4">Founder Term Sheet FAQ</h2><div class="measure"><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqList"><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-0"><span>Why does DBERT prefer advisory shares (FAST) over early priced equity rounds?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-0" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Executing a formal priced equity valuation or shareholder formalization across Indian corporate legal jurisdictions (MCA/FDI compliance) can consume months of costly operational overhead. Founder Advisor Standard Template (FAST) agreements simply execute a milestone-driven advisory grant that instantly aligns engineering deliverables without complicating your early capitalization table or holding up ongoing engineering sprint velocity.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-1"><span>What happens to the assigned intellectual property (IP) if engineering milestones are missed?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-1" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Our standardized legal contracts contain strict milestone-gated equity tranches. Every individual sprint deliverable (e.g., custom RAG pipeline deployment, vector indexing optimization, UI/UX client release) must formally pass rigorous integration criteria on your Git repository before the associated equity tranche vests. If milestones remain unfulfilled, zero equity vests and you retain complete legal rights to all contributed codebase commits up to that point.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>Are DBERT term sheets legally compliant with Indian Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) guidelines?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Yes. Our reference frameworks are adapted specifically for Indian entities incorporated under the Companies Act (2013), seamlessly integrating with official Udyam/MSME recognition parameters, standard shareholder agreement (SHA) protection clauses, and statutory sweat equity or ESOP pool allocations.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>Can we alter or modify these reference term sheet clauses with our corporate legal counsel?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Absolutely. We actively encourage founders to review every section of our standardized open-source templates alongside independent corporate legal advisors. Our aim is total transparency and mutual execution speed, not rigid or predatory contractual entrapment.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-4"><span>How does this equity model interact with subsequent institutional VC funding rounds?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-4" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>DBERT advisory equity grants act as lightweight common or advisory allocations that sit alongside standard founder equity. When you transition into formal Seed or Series A financing rounds led by institutional venture funds (such as Y Combinator, Peak XV, or Blume Ventures), our equity simply converts or dilutes alongside founding shareholders according to standard industry pro-rata practices.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-5"><span>Is there any retrospective cash financial obligation if our enterprise pivots or shuts down?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-5" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Never. We act as genuine engineering co-builders who intentionally share venture execution risk alongside you. If your startup undergoes a commercial pivot or ultimately ceases operations, the granted equity simply dissolves without any retrospective cash clawback or financial indebtedness for technical sprints performed.</p></div></div></div></div></section><div class="card bg-card p-8 rounded-lg border border-line text-center"><div class="doclabel mb-1">§ 06 — INITIALIZE COLLABORATION</div><h2 class="card-title text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">Ready to Build With Aligned Technical Leadership?</h2><p class="text-sm text-muted max-w-lg mx-auto mb-6">Submit your pitch deck and architecture summary today. Serving open-weights models (such as Llama-3 and Qwen) locally via vLLM or Ollama inside an isolated VPC guarantees total mathematical privacy and fixed, predictable infrastructure costs.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-1"><span>Which cloud GPU platforms and instance configurations do you deploy for incubated startups?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-1" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We deploy multi-cloud compute architecture across AWS EC2 (G4dn, G5, and P4 instances), GCP, RunPod bare-metal GPU nodes, and Lambda Labs. By automating dynamic node scaling and spot-instance redundancy, we reduce computational operational costs by up to 60% compared to default cloud provider setups.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>How do you structure high-performance vector databases for enterprise RAG retrieval?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We build hardened PostgreSQL database clusters equipped with the pgvector extension. We configure specialized indexing algorithms—including Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) and Inverted File Flat (IVFFlat)—to guarantee sub-100ms semantic search queries even across multi-million document embedding vector stores.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>How do you protect private model runtimes from distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>All backend model serving endpoints reside behind strict Nginx reverse proxies configured with rate-limiting token buckets, IP filtering, and SSL TLS termination. External requests never communicate directly with bare-metal GPU inference ports.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-4"><span>Is continuous infrastructure health monitoring and database backup management included?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-4" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Yes. Every enterprise infrastructure build incorporates automated daily automated encrypted snapshot backups for PostgreSQL vector volumes, alongside real-time Prometheus and Grafana alerting dashboards tracking VRAM consumption, token generation throughput, and error rates.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="container pad-block border-t border-line"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 09 — RELATED INCUBATION SERVICES &amp; Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) are better suited for closely held bootstrapped professional service firms.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-1"><span>How long does the complete SPICe+ incorporation and DPIIT recognition timeline typically take?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-1" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Standard MCA SPICe+ entity incorporation—including Digital Signature Certificates (DSC), Director Identification Numbers (DIN), PAN, and GST allocation—typically completes within 7 to 10 working days. Subsequent DPIIT Startup India recognition completes within 2 to 3 weeks upon submission of technical validation proofs.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>What are the core income tax exemptions and capital benefits unlocked by DPIIT Startup India registration?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Recognized startups gain access to Section 80-IAC income tax exemptions for 3 consecutive years out of their initial 10 years, exemption from angel tax under Section 56(2)(viib), self-certification under labor laws, and fast-tracked patent application facilitation with up to an 80% government fee rebate.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>How do your standardized agreements protect founder equity from early departed co-founders or developers?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We deploy strict 4-year founder equity vesting schedules incorporating a mandatory 1-year cliff and robust Good Reason/Cause definitions. If a co-founder departs during the first 12 months, unvested equity is automatically absorbed back into the corporate equity reserve without disputational deadlock.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-4"><span>Do you provide specialized AI model legal terms and intellectual property assignment contracts?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-4" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Yes.
