and founder rhetoric. Because DBERT Labs operates an active software laboratory and venture studio, our evaluation is fundamentally deterministic and architectural. We code-audit every portfolio founder’s actual Git repository, test their database RAG semantic indexing speeds, verify their Docker container scalability, and assess real computing unit economics before ever presenting deal flow to our network.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-1"><span>What is the corporate fee structure for accredited investors and VCs to access DBERT deal flow?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-1" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Joining the DBERT Investor Network is completely fee-free for verified accredited angel investors, seed syndicates, and institutional venture capital partners. We do not charge subscription management retainers or introductory broker surcharges to inspect deal flow. Our economic alignment derives directly from holding equity stakes (2% to 8%) in the portfolio companies we technically co-develop, ensuring our incentives are identical to incoming coinvestors.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>How does DBERT studio co-development eliminate early execution failure risk for seed investors?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Statistical failure across pre-seed software startups occurs primarily when non-technical founders expend their cash seed capital contracting mediocre external outsourcing agencies—resulting in architectural collapse, security breaches, or exhausted operating runways before launching an MVP. DBERT eradicates execution risk by deploying our in-house senior full-stack AI engineering squads directly into portfolio ventures under a dilution-free services-against-equity exchange, guaranteeing carrier-grade MVP deployment within a 90-day sprint.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>At what valuation stages and funding milestones do investors receive portfolio introductions?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We introduce portfolio founders to our investor network at two strategic inflection points: immediately upon achieving verified production technical launch (Pre-Seed/Angel rounds seeking ₹25,00,000 to ₹1,00,00,000 in early expansion capital) and post-revenue scaling milestones (Seed/Series A expansion rounds). src="/alkame.png"/></div><div class="doclabel">§ 01 — FINTECH CASE STUDY <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div></div><h1 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__heroTitle">Alkame Inc.</h1><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__heroLede">Calibrated, conformal-prediction market intelligence across the NIFTY 500 — an applied research program DBERT incubates in exchange for equity.</p><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__btnRow"><a href="https://alkameinc.info/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm">Visit Alkame ↗</a><a href="https://github.com/Alkameinc/alkame-nifty-50-educational/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm">View GitHub Repo ↗</a></div></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__facts"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factsLabel">At a Glance</p><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factsList"><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">₹1.2Cr</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">Research contribution — DBERT services delivered in exchange for equity</p></div><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">4 Months</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">May – August 2026 applied research program</p></div><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">6,300+ Stocks</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">NIFTY 500 universe, sub-100ms ingestion latency</p></div></div></div></div></div><h2 class="sr-only">Research Methodology &amp; System Architecture</h2><div class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__bar"><div class="container AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__row"><span class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__label">Jump to:</span><a href="#research-question" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__linkActive">Research Question</a><a href="#architecture" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Architecture</a><a href="#challenges" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Challenges</a><a href="#timeline" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Timeline</a><a href="#team" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Team</a></div></div><div id="research-question" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">01</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->01<!-- --> — <!-- -->THE RESEARCH QUESTION</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Why Calibrated Confidence Matters</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">A documented gap between unregulated retail-facing signals and validated confidence — grounded in SEBI’s own regulatory data.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stack3"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__statGrid"><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">+41%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">YoY rise in aggregate retail derivative losses — ₹1,05,603cr in FY25</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~91%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">of individual traders ended FY25 in loss, averaging ~₹1.1 lakh each</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~20%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">YoY decline in unique traders even as losses rose — a structural, not cyclical, pattern</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~2%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">of financial “finfluencers” are SEBI-registered, yet 82% of investors act on their advice anyway</p></div></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__source">Sources: SEBI, Jul 2025; CFA Institute, 2025.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__question">Alkame-Nifty50 tests one falsifiable question: does enforcing calibrated confidence as a display gate — via split conformal prediction — and walk-forward, cost-aware validation as a promotion gate, produce lower calibration error and comparable-or-better risk-adjusted edge than Microsoft’s Qlib and a naive rule-based baseline?</p><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__accentCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__disclaimer">This is a pre-registered study design. No empirical results are claimed here — the research team has committed in advance to report the outcome whichever direction it points.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="positioning" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">02</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->02<!-- --> — <!-- -->GROUNDED IN RESEARCH</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Where This Sits vs. Existing Work</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Alkame-Nifty50’s contribution is architectural and applied, not a new algorithm — it integrates findings that, on their own, stop short of a production system.</p></div><div><div class="forms-module__s9hc7W__stack2"><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Kaya &amp; Nguyen (2025)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Conformal prediction achieves error rates tracking nominal significance levels, on 764 US large/mid-cap stocks, Jan 2022–Jan 2024.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>Small-scale, US-only proof of concept — not India-specific, not integrated into a production pipeline with drift detection.</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Bailey et al. (2014)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Formal proof that backtest overfitting is a near-inevitable statistical artifact of testing many configurations.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>Diagnoses the problem rigorously, but is a methodology paper — no live architecture for continuously re-validating deployed models.</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Gama et al. (2014)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Establishes the standard taxonomy of concept drift (sudden, gradual, incremental, recurring) in ML broadly.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>General-purpose survey, not applied to retail financial signal generation or tied to audit/regulatory requirements.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="architecture" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">03</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->03<!-- --> — <!-- -->SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">How Alkame-Nifty50 Is Built</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Four layers, each built to resist a specific, documented failure mode in retail-facing quantitative trading tools.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarGrid"><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Model Layer</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Per-symbol, per-horizon ensembles — logistic regression, random forest, gradient-boosted trees, and a stacking combiner — trained under strict no-lookahead discipline.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Calibration Layer</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Split conformal prediction sits on top of every model output. A prediction is only surfaced once its prediction set collapses to a single label — a distribution-free coverage guarantee, not a raw softmax score.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Drift Detection &amp; Retraining</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Every prediction — shown or withheld — is logged with a resolvable outcome. A retrained model must re-clear the same validation gates before replacing production, never auto-promoted.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Validation Gate</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Walk-forward backtesting across multiple non-overlapping windows, with explicit transaction-cost and slippage modeling, gates any promotion.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="challenges" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">04</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->04<!-- --> — <!-- -->ENGINEERING CHALLENGES</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Technical Difficulties &amp; How We Approached Them</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Five specific, well-documented failure modes shaped this design — each paired with the concrete choice made to address it, and the research it draws on.</p></div><div><div class="forms-module__s9hc7W__stack2"><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Most retail-facing prediction tools report a point prediction with no validated measure of confidence.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Split conformal prediction as a display gate — a call is only shown once its prediction set collapses to a single label, chosen over Platt scaling or isotonic regression for its distribution-free coverage guarantee.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Kaya &amp; Nguyen, 2025</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>A single attractive backtest is a well-documented statistical trap — testing many configurations can make a strategy look strong purely by chance.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Every candidate model clears a walk-forward, multi-window, cost-and-slippage-aware validation gate before promotion. One good backtest is necessary, never sufficient.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Bailey, Borwein, López de Prado &amp; Zhu, 2014</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Live markets drift, so a model validated last quarter can silently decay without anyone noticing.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>A Prediction Ledger logs every prediction against its eventual resolved outcome. Sustained degradation triggers retraining — the retrained model re-clears the same gates, no shortcuts.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Gama et al., 2014</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Comparing a new architecture fairly against existing tooling, rather than a strawman.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>The evaluation protocol benchmarks against Qlib — Microsoft’s open-source quant research platform — on identical data and time windows, plus a naive rule-based floor.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Yang, Liu, Zhou, Bian &amp; Liu, 2020</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>India’s regulatory footing for algorithmic and &quot;black box&quot; signal providers changed materially in 2025.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Scope is deliberately restricted to signal-quality assessment, not automated order execution — staying on the lower-friction research/signal side of SEBI’s new principal-agent framework.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">SEBI, Feb 2025</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="regulatory" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">05</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->05<!-- --> — <!-- -->COMPLIANCE BY DESIGN</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Built Against a Moving Regulatory Target</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">SEBI’s February 2025 circular introduced India’s first governance framework for retail algo trading — this changes how a system like Alkame must be classified.</p></div><div><div class="card"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBody alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBodySpaced">Under SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000013 (Feb 2025), stockbrokers are the <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">principal</span>, and any algo provider acts as their<!-- --> <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">agent</span>. Algorithms are classified as disclosed or<!-- --> <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">undisclosed (“black box”)</span> — Alkame’s ML ensemble falls in the latter category by construction.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBody">The project stays on the research/signal side of this line rather than automated execution — the compliance layer hard-blocks any output that reads as personalized advice or unauthorized order placement, avoiding the higher-friction execution regulatory bracket.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite alkame-module__kSbqrG__citeSpaced">SEBI, Feb 2025</p></div></div></div></div></div><div id="timeline" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">06</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->06<!-- --> — <!-- -->RESEARCH TIMELINE</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">A 4-Month Applied Research Program</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">May through August 2026, moving from infrastructure and model-building through live validation and drift monitoring.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timeline"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineRail"></div><div class="stack"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">MAY 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Data infrastructure and feature-store setup across NIFTY 500 constituents; no-lookahead discipline established.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">JUNE 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Model ensembles and the conformal calibration layer built out; Qlib and naive baselines prepared for matched comparison.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">JULY 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Walk-forward validation protocol executed; Prediction Ledger begins logging live, resolvable outcomes.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">AUGUST 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Live drift-monitoring window and program wrap-up; findings reported per the pre-registration commitments, in either direction.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="team" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__teamBand"><div class="container"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__teamHeader"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 05 — CONTRIBUTING RESEARCH TEAM</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__teamTitle">Interns Currently Working on Alkame</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__teamLede">Meet the DBERT interns actively contributing to this research program.</p></div><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__emptyState">Loading contributors…</p><div class="forms-module__s9hc7W__centerBlock"><button class="btn btn-outline btn-lg">Currently working on this project? class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__logoImg" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;color:transparent" src="/cognitive.png"/></div><div class="doclabel">§ 01 — VENTURE CASE STUDY ANALYSIS <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div><div class="stack-h justify-center align-baseline gap-3 flex-wrap"><h1>Cognitive Solutions</h1><span class="handnote" aria-hidden="true">audited production architecture ✍</span></div><p><a href="https://www.cognitivesolutions.site/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__siteLink">Visit Website (<!-- -->cognitivesolutions.site<!-- -->) ↗</a></p></div><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__body"><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Challenge</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Cognitive Solutions aimed to establish a scalable talent acquisition model to support their growing client integrations across Robotics, IoT, and AI agent frameworks. Their internal training infrastructure was unable to keep pace with client project onboarding, leading to resource delays and bottlenecks in their hardware-software integration pipeline.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT engineered a shared training framework and custom recruitment pathway. We synchronized Cognitive Solutions&#x27; stack parameters (ROS, Python automation, and device communication protocols) with our advanced learner curricula. We then established a targeted placement channel that pre-vetted interns through live simulation reviews before deployment.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">The collaborative pipeline successfully trained and placed qualified junior developers directly into live AI, IoT, and robotics integration projects. Technical onboarding time was reduced by 60%, allowing Cognitive Solutions to meet all client deployment schedules.</p></section><section class="card CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsCard"><h2 class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsTitle">Key Metrics</h2><p class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsValue">60% Reduction in Onboarding | 100% Client Deployment Compliance</p></section><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__foot"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/startups/register">Get Similar Support for Your Startup</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. class="doclabel">§ 01 — VENTURE CASE STUDY ANALYSIS <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div><div class="stack-h justify-center align-baseline gap-3 flex-wrap"><h1>Digital Blaize</h1><span class="handnote" aria-hidden="true">audited production architecture ✍</span></div><p><a href="https://digitalblaize.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__siteLink">Visit Website (<!-- -->digitalblaize.com<!-- -->) ↗</a></p></div><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__body"><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Challenge</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Digital Blaize aimed to scale its multi-disciplinary educational programs across diverse technological sectors (including Robotics, AI/ML engineering, IoT setups, and Python Automation). To sustain this expansion, they required a steady pipeline of skilled developers capable of maintaining student platforms and co-developing curriculum sandbox environments.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT incubated their growth model, establishing direct pipelines to our upskilled student network. We deployed interns specializing in full-stack Next.js interfaces, automated grading systems, and database configurations. Additionally, DBERT&#x27;s technical mentors reviewed and optimized their core learning management portal.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Digital Blaize successfully scaled its curriculum delivery across 6 technical domains. More than 500 learners received hands-on training using sandbox portals developed by DBERT-deployed engineers, and platform load capacity was improved by 40%.</p></section><section class="card CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsCard"><h2 class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsTitle">Key Metrics</h2><p class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsValue">6 Technical Domains | 500+ Learners | 40% Load Improvement</p></section><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__foot"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/startups/register">Get Similar Support for Your Startup</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. They faced significant hurdles in optimizing model weight parameters for standard school CPUs and structuring clear API wrappers for students learning AI concepts in public registries.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT Labs spearheaded the open-source collaboration, delegating technical researchers and developers to commit directly to their repository. We designed modular multi-agent orchestration libraries, configured automated validation setups to review student-submitted prompts, and optimized local model pipelines utilizing Ollama integrations.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">The collaborative open-source partnership successfully published the Gayatri-AI framework. The libraries now support lightweight, offline-first multi-agent systems, enabling school environments to run interactive AI agent demonstrations on existing lab computers with sub-2s generation latency.</p></section><section class="card CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsCard"><h2 class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsTitle">Key Metrics</h2><p class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsValue">10+ Schools Deployed | ₹0 API Costs | Open Source</p></section><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__foot"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/startups/register">Get Similar Support for Your Startup</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. MegaMenu-module__8k9CWa__drawerHandnote">handmade in Delhi ✍</span></div></div></div></div><main id="main-content" class="app-main"><div><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__hero"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__heroGrid"><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__logoRow"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__logoFrame"><img alt="Alkame Inc. Logo" loading="lazy" decoding="async" data-nimg="fill" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__logoImg" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;color:transparent" src="/alkame.png"/></div><div class="doclabel">§ 01 — FINTECH CASE STUDY <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div></div><h1 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__heroTitle">Alkame Inc.</h1><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__heroLede">Calibrated, conformal-prediction market intelligence across the NIFTY 500 — an applied research program DBERT incubates in exchange for equity.</p><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__btnRow"><a href="https://alkameinc.info/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm">Visit Alkame ↗</a><a href="https://github.com/Alkameinc/alkame-nifty-50-educational/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="btn btn-outline btn-sm">View GitHub Repo ↗</a></div></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__facts"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factsLabel">At a Glance</p><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factsList"><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">₹1.2Cr</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">Research contribution — DBERT services delivered in exchange for equity</p></div><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">4 Months</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">May – August 2026 applied research program</p></div><div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factValue">6,300+ Stocks</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__factNote">NIFTY 500 universe, sub-100ms ingestion latency</p></div></div></div></div></div><h2 class="sr-only">Research Methodology &amp; System Architecture</h2><div class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__bar"><div class="container AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__row"><span class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__label">Jump to:</span><a href="#research-question" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__linkActive">Research Question</a><a href="#architecture" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Architecture</a><a href="#challenges" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Challenges</a><a href="#timeline" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Timeline</a><a href="#team" class="AlkameJumpNav-module__YOfwaW__link">Team</a></div></div><div id="research-question" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">01</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->01<!-- --> — <!-- -->THE RESEARCH QUESTION</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Why Calibrated Confidence Matters</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">A documented gap between unregulated retail-facing signals and validated confidence — grounded in SEBI’s own regulatory data.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stack3"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__statGrid"><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">+41%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">YoY rise in aggregate retail derivative losses — ₹1,05,603cr in FY25</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~91%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">of individual traders ended FY25 in loss, averaging ~₹1.1 lakh each</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~20%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">YoY decline in unique traders even as losses rose — a structural, not cyclical, pattern</p></div><div class="card forms-module__s9hc7W__errorTint"><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__figure">~2%</p><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__metaLine">of financial “finfluencers” are SEBI-registered, yet 82% of investors act on their advice anyway</p></div></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__source">Sources: SEBI, Jul 2025; CFA Institute, 2025.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__question">Alkame-Nifty50 tests one falsifiable question: does enforcing calibrated confidence as a display gate — via split conformal prediction — and walk-forward, cost-aware validation as a promotion gate, produce lower calibration error and comparable-or-better risk-adjusted edge than Microsoft’s Qlib and a naive rule-based baseline?</p><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__accentCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__disclaimer">This is a pre-registered study design. No empirical results are claimed here — the research team has committed in advance to report the outcome whichever direction it points.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="positioning" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">02</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->02<!-- --> — <!-- -->GROUNDED IN RESEARCH</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Where This Sits vs. Existing Work</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Alkame-Nifty50’s contribution is architectural and applied, not a new algorithm — it integrates findings that, on their own, stop short of a production system.</p></div><div><div class="forms-module__s9hc7W__stack2"><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Kaya &amp; Nguyen (2025)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Conformal prediction achieves error rates tracking nominal significance levels, on 764 US large/mid-cap stocks, Jan 2022–Jan 2024.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>Small-scale, US-only proof of concept — not India-specific, not integrated into a production pipeline with drift detection.</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Bailey et al. (2014)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Formal proof that backtest overfitting is a near-inevitable statistical artifact of testing many configurations.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>Diagnoses the problem rigorously, but is a methodology paper — no live architecture for continuously re-validating deployed models.</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorWork">Gama et al. (2014)</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorContribution">Establishes the standard taxonomy of concept drift (sudden, gradual, incremental, recurring) in ML broadly.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__priorGap"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strong">Gap this project addresses: </span>General-purpose survey, not applied to retail financial signal generation or tied to audit/regulatory requirements.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="architecture" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">03</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->03<!-- --> — <!-- -->SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">How Alkame-Nifty50 Is Built</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Four layers, each built to resist a specific, documented failure mode in retail-facing quantitative trading tools.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarGrid"><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Model Layer</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Per-symbol, per-horizon ensembles — logistic regression, random forest, gradient-boosted trees, and a stacking combiner — trained under strict no-lookahead discipline.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Calibration Layer</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Split conformal prediction sits on top of every model output. A prediction is only surfaced once its prediction set collapses to a single label — a distribution-free coverage guarantee, not a raw softmax score.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Drift Detection &amp; Retraining</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Every prediction — shown or withheld — is logged with a resolvable outcome. A retrained model must re-clear the same validation gates before replacing production, never auto-promoted.</p></div><div class="card"><h3 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarTitle">Validation Gate</h3><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__pillarBody">Walk-forward backtesting across multiple non-overlapping windows, with explicit transaction-cost and slippage modeling, gates any promotion.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="challenges" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">04</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->04<!-- --> — <!-- -->ENGINEERING CHALLENGES</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Technical Difficulties &amp; How We Approached Them</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">Five specific, well-documented failure modes shaped this design — each paired with the concrete choice made to address it, and the research it draws on.</p></div><div><div class="forms-module__s9hc7W__stack2"><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Most retail-facing prediction tools report a point prediction with no validated measure of confidence.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Split conformal prediction as a display gate — a call is only shown once its prediction set collapses to a single label, chosen over Platt scaling or isotonic regression for its distribution-free coverage guarantee.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Kaya &amp; Nguyen, 2025</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>A single attractive backtest is a well-documented statistical trap — testing many configurations can make a strategy look strong purely by chance.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Every candidate model clears a walk-forward, multi-window, cost-and-slippage-aware validation gate before promotion. One good backtest is necessary, never sufficient.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Bailey, Borwein, López de Prado &amp; Zhu, 2014</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Live markets drift, so a model validated last quarter can silently decay without anyone noticing.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>A Prediction Ledger logs every prediction against its eventual resolved outcome. Sustained degradation triggers retraining — the retrained model re-clears the same gates, no shortcuts.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Gama et al., 2014</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>Comparing a new architecture fairly against existing tooling, rather than a strawman.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>The evaluation protocol benchmarks against Qlib — Microsoft’s open-source quant research platform — on identical data and time windows, plus a naive rule-based floor.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">Yang, Liu, Zhou, Bian &amp; Liu, 2020</p></div><div class="card alkame-module__kSbqrG__compactCard"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problem"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__problemLabel">Problem — </span>India’s regulatory footing for algorithmic and &quot;black box&quot; signal providers changed materially in 2025.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approach"><span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__approachLabel">Approach — </span>Scope is deliberately restricted to signal-quality assessment, not automated order execution — staying on the lower-friction research/signal side of SEBI’s new principal-agent framework.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite">SEBI, Feb 2025</p></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="regulatory" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">05</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->05<!-- --> — <!-- -->COMPLIANCE BY DESIGN</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">Built Against a Moving Regulatory Target</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">SEBI’s February 2025 circular introduced India’s first governance framework for retail algo trading — this changes how a system like Alkame must be classified.</p></div><div><div class="card"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBody alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBodySpaced">Under SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000013 (Feb 2025), stockbrokers are the <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">principal</span>, and any algo provider acts as their<!-- --> <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">agent</span>. Algorithms are classified as disclosed or<!-- --> <span class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__strongText">undisclosed (“black box”)</span> — Alkame’s ML ensemble falls in the latter category by construction.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__regBody">The project stays on the research/signal side of this line rather than automated execution — the compliance layer hard-blocks any output that reads as personalized advice or unauthorized order placement, avoiding the higher-friction execution regulatory bracket.</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__cite alkame-module__kSbqrG__citeSpaced">SEBI, Feb 2025</p></div></div></div></div></div><div id="timeline" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__row"><div class="container alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowBody"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyGrid"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__stickyCol"><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowIndex">06</p><div class="doclabel">§ <!-- -->06<!-- --> — <!-- -->RESEARCH TIMELINE</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowTitle">A 4-Month Applied Research Program</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__rowNote">May through August 2026, moving from infrastructure and model-building through live validation and drift monitoring.</p></div><div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timeline"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineRail"></div><div class="stack"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">MAY 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Data infrastructure and feature-store setup across NIFTY 500 constituents; no-lookahead discipline established.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">JUNE 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Model ensembles and the conformal calibration layer built out; Qlib and naive baselines prepared for matched comparison.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">JULY 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Walk-forward validation protocol executed; Prediction Ledger begins logging live, resolvable outcomes.</p></div><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineItem"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineDot"></div><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineMonth">AUGUST 2026</p><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__timelineBody">Live drift-monitoring window and program wrap-up; findings reported per the pre-registration commitments, in either direction.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div id="team" class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__teamBand"><div class="container"><div class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__teamHeader"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 05 — CONTRIBUTING RESEARCH TEAM</div><h2 class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__teamTitle">Interns Currently Working on Alkame</h2><p class="alkame-module__kSbqrG__teamLede">Meet the DBERT interns actively contributing to this research program.</p></div><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__emptyState">Loading contributors…</p><div class="forms-module__s9hc7W__centerBlock"><button class="btn btn-outline btn-lg">Currently working on this project? 01 — VENTURE CASE STUDY ANALYSIS <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div><div class="stack-h justify-center align-baseline gap-3 flex-wrap"><h1>Cognitive Solutions</h1><span class="handnote" aria-hidden="true">audited production architecture ✍</span></div><p><a href="https://www.cognitivesolutions.site/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__siteLink">Visit Website (<!-- -->cognitivesolutions.site<!-- -->) ↗</a></p></div><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__body"><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Challenge</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Cognitive Solutions aimed to establish a scalable talent acquisition model to support their growing client integrations across Robotics, IoT, and AI agent frameworks. Their internal training infrastructure was unable to keep pace with client project onboarding, leading to resource delays and bottlenecks in their hardware-software integration pipeline.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT engineered a shared training framework and custom recruitment pathway. We synchronized Cognitive Solutions&#x27; stack parameters (ROS, Python automation, and device communication protocols) with our advanced learner curricula. We then established a targeted placement channel that pre-vetted interns through live simulation reviews before deployment.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">The collaborative pipeline successfully trained and placed qualified junior developers directly into live AI, IoT, and robotics integration projects. Technical onboarding time was reduced by 60%, allowing Cognitive Solutions to meet all client deployment schedules.</p></section><section class="card CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsCard"><h2 class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsTitle">Key Metrics</h2><p class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsValue">60% Reduction in Onboarding | 100% Client Deployment Compliance</p></section><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__foot"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/startups/register/">Get Similar Support for Your Startup</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. class="doclabel">§ 01 — VENTURE CASE STUDY ANALYSIS <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div><div class="stack-h justify-center align-baseline gap-3 flex-wrap"><h1>Digital Blaize</h1><span class="handnote" aria-hidden="true">audited production architecture ✍</span></div><p><a href="https://digitalblaize.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__siteLink">Visit Website (<!-- -->digitalblaize.com<!-- -->) ↗</a></p></div><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__body"><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Challenge</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Digital Blaize aimed to scale its multi-disciplinary educational programs across diverse technological sectors (including Robotics, AI/ML engineering, IoT setups, and Python Automation). To sustain this expansion, they required a steady pipeline of skilled developers capable of maintaining student platforms and co-developing curriculum sandbox environments.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT incubated their growth model, establishing direct pipelines to our upskilled student network. We deployed interns specializing in full-stack Next.js interfaces, automated grading systems, and database configurations. Additionally, DBERT&#x27;s technical mentors reviewed and optimized their core learning management portal.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Digital Blaize successfully scaled its curriculum delivery across 6 technical domains. More than 500 learners received hands-on training using sandbox portals developed by DBERT-deployed engineers, and platform load capacity was improved by 40%.</p></section><section class="card CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsCard"><h2 class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsTitle">Key Metrics</h2><p class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsValue">6 Technical Domains | 500+ Learners | 40% Load Improvement</p></section><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__foot"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/startups/register/">Get Similar Support for Your Startup</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__logoImg" style="position:absolute;height:100%;width:100%;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;color:transparent" src="/gayatri-ai.png"/></div><div class="doclabel">§ 01 — VENTURE CASE STUDY ANALYSIS <span class="rev">rev: 2026.2</span></div><div class="stack-h justify-center align-baseline gap-3 flex-wrap"><h1>Gayatri AI</h1><span class="handnote" aria-hidden="true">audited production architecture ✍</span></div><p><a href="https://gayatridevi.ai/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__siteLink">Visit Website (<!-- -->gayatridevi.ai<!-- -->) ↗</a></p></div><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__body"><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Challenge</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">Gayatri AI sought to establish open-source educational frameworks capable of deploying localized, low-resource AI agent nodes in classroom environments. They faced significant hurdles in optimizing model weight parameters for standard school CPUs and structuring clear API wrappers for students learning AI concepts in public registries.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">What DBERT Provided</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">DBERT Labs spearheaded the open-source collaboration, delegating technical researchers and developers to commit directly to their repository. We designed modular multi-agent orchestration libraries, configured automated validation setups to review student-submitted prompts, and optimized local model pipelines utilizing Ollama integrations.</p></section><section class="card"><h2 class="card-title">The Outcome</h2><p class="forms-module__s9hc7W__cardCopy">The collaborative open-source partnership successfully published the Gayatri-AI framework. The libraries now support lightweight, offline-first multi-agent systems, enabling school environments to run interactive AI agent demonstrations on existing lab computers with sub-2s generation latency.</p></section><section class="card CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsCard"><h2 class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsTitle">Key Metrics</h2><p class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__metricsValue">10+ Schools Deployed | ₹0 API Costs | Open Source</p></section><div class="CaseStudyTemplate-module__3WDZta__foot"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="/startups/register/">Get Similar Support for Your Startup</a></div></div></div><!--$--><!--/$--></main><footer class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__footer" role="contentinfo"><div class="wrap"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__grid"><div class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandCol"><a class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logo" href="/"><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__logoMark" aria-hidden="true">D</span><span class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__brandName">DBERT</span></a><p class="Footer-module__3hUVsW__blurb">Digital Blinc Education Research And Technology. Tranches open as our co-development engineering squads meet defined architectural milestones—such as deploying a live pgvector indexing register, achieving sub-100ms API inference latency, or onboarding your first 100 enterprise trial users.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>How do you structure warm referrals to active technology angel investors and venture capitalists?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We reject bulk mail merges and blind LinkedIn blasting. When your AI product reaches verified deployment stability, DBERT engineering partners conduct direct introduction calls with curated active tech investors from our proprietary venture network who understand technical AI architecture.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>Can you assist founders in preparing financial projections and dilution cap table scenarios?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Yes. Our financial modeling mentors work directly with you to construct mathematically rigorous pro-forma financial models, burn-rate runway forecasts, and SAFE note cap-table dilution scenarios that survive scrutiny from tier-1 institutional due diligence teams.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-4"><span>What items belong in a complete institutional technical data room prior to raising pre-seed capital?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-4" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>An institutional-grade AI technical data room must include GitHub codebase architecture diagrams, executed founder IP assignment NDAs, open-source model license compliance schedules (MIT, Apache 2.0), historical database latency benchmarks, and verified third-party cloud hosting vulnerability assessments.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="container pad-block border-t border-line"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 09 — RELATED INCUBATION SERVICES &amp; They do not constitute formal binding legal advice. Startup founders must independently consult qualified Indian corporate legal counsel before formally incorporating agreements or legally modifying share capital tables under the Companies Act (2013).</p></div><section class="mb-lg"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 02 — CO-DEVELOPMENT EQUITY TIERS</div><h2 class="section-title mb-3">The 2% – 8% Standardized Co-Development Model</h2><p class="prose-lg mb-4 text-muted">Our advisory equity engagements are explicitly categorized into three rigid structural tiers based directly upon engineering labor volume, compute infrastructure complexity, and dedicated sprint team duration. Every level utilizes standardized Founder Advisor Standard Template (FAST) or sweat equity shareholder structures designed to integrate without friction into subsequent institutional fundraising due diligence.</p><div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3 my-6"><div class="card p-5 bg-card border border-line flex flex-col justify-between"><div><span class="font-mono text-xs text-accent uppercase tracking-wider">Tier 1 · Advisory Level</span><h3 class="card-heading-lg mt-1 mb-2 text-white">2% – 3% Advisory Equity</h3><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed mb-4">Targeted at technical founders who possess active internal code execution squads but require experienced senior enterprise systems architecture oversite to avoid scaling bottlenecks and infrastructure security misconfigurations.</p><ul class="list-disc pl-4 text-xs text-muted space-y-1"><li>Weekly architectural codebase pull-request reviews</li><li>Vector database indexing &amp; RAG schema optimization</li><li>Direct access to our audited <a class="ink-link" href="/startups/services/hiring">1,500+ developer hiring pool</a></li><li>Official Udyam/MSME corporate technical audits</li></ul></div><div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-line text-right font-mono text-xs text-muted">Vesting: 2-Year (6-Month Cliff)</div></div><div class="card p-5 bg-card border-2 border-accent flex flex-col justify-between relative"><div class="absolute -top-3 right-4 bg-accent text-zinc-950 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded">Most Deployed</div><div><span class="font-mono text-xs text-accent uppercase tracking-wider">Tier 2 · Co-Development</span><h3 class="card-heading-lg mt-1 mb-2 text-white">4% – 5% Sprint Equity</h3><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed mb-4">Designed for pre-seed founders and domain experts who need complete zero-to-production execution of their initial minimum viable commercial AI product without spending capital on external software development agency invoices.</p><ul class="list-disc pl-4 text-xs text-muted space-y-1"><li><strong>4 to 8 week agile code engineering sprints</strong></li><li>Dedicated full-stack React/Next.js UI/UX production</li><li>Containerized MLOps server orchestration setup</li><li>Non-dilutive cloud compute seed grant eligibility</li></ul></div><div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-line text-right font-mono text-xs text-muted">Vesting: Milestone-Gated Tranches</div></div><div class="card p-5 bg-card border border-line flex flex-col justify-between"><div><span class="font-mono text-xs text-accent uppercase tracking-wider">Tier 3 · Venture Partner</span><h3 class="card-heading-lg mt-1 mb-2 text-white">6% – 8% Venture Equity</h3><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed mb-4">A deeply integrated structural co-founding partnership. Below, we publish our core architectural clauses complete with explicit translation notes explaining why each term exists and how it actively safeguards founder rights.</p><div class="space-y-6"><div class="p-5 bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-lg border border-line"><div class="flex justify-between align-start mb-2"><h3 class="font-mono text-sm text-white font-bold">Clause 1: Milestone-Gated IP &amp; Code Assignment</h3><span class="badge badge-accent font-mono text-xs">Founder Protection</span></div><p class="font-mono text-xs text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-950 p-3 rounded border border-zinc-800 mb-3 leading-relaxed">&quot;All intellectual property, proprietary source code commits, custom model weight embeddings, and algorithmic documentation authored by DBERT technical squads under this agreement shall be automatically, irrevocably, and exclusively assigned to the Startup corporate entity immediately upon validation and integration of each designated sprint milestone deliverable into the official main source control branch.&quot;</p><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed"><strong>Why we structure it this way:</strong> Most traditional software agencies withhold intellectual property ownership until full financial completion invoices are settled. In an equity co-development relationship, you must hold unimpeded legal ownership over your source code at every progressive stage of growth to satisfy external investor legal due diligence and maintain technical self-reliance.</p></div><div class="p-5 bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-lg border border-line"><div class="flex justify-between align-start mb-2"><h3 class="font-mono text-sm text-white font-bold">Clause 2: Anti-Clawback &amp; Shared Execution Risk</h3><span class="badge badge-emerald font-mono text-xs">Zero Financial Risk</span></div><p class="font-mono text-xs text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-950 p-3 rounded border border-zinc-800 mb-3 leading-relaxed">&quot;In the event that the Startup commercial venture is formally concluded, restructured, or commercially unsuccessful prior to the realization of a liquidity event or public offering, DBERT expressly waives any right, option, or claim to financial recovery, retrospective labor fee conversion, or cash reimbursement for engineering development sprints rendered.&quot;</p><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed"><strong>Why we structure it this way:</strong> Building innovative artificial intelligence software carries inherent algorithmic and commercial adoption risks. When we sign an incubation term sheet, we step onto your cap table as authentic co-builders—we consciously assume execution risk alongside you rather than functioning as speculative debt collectors.</p></div><div class="p-5 bg-zinc-900/60 rounded-lg border border-line"><div class="flex justify-between align-start mb-2"><h3 class="font-mono text-sm text-white font-bold">Clause 3: Non-Interfering Governance &amp; Pro-Rata Dilution</h3><span class="badge badge-blue font-mono text-xs">Cap Table Cleanliness</span></div><p class="font-mono text-xs text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-950 p-3 rounded border border-zinc-800 mb-3 leading-relaxed">&quot;Advisory Shares issued under this agreement shall constitute standard voting or non-voting common stock equivalents carrying zero blocking rights, veto authority, or preferred operational governance mandates over executive corporate decision-making. Upon the execution of subsequent priced financing rounds, DBERT equity shall subject itself to proportional pro-rata dilution identical to founding common shareholders.&quot;</p><p class="text-xs text-muted leading-relaxed"><strong>Why we structure it this way:</strong> Institutional venture capital investors intensely dislike bloated early advisory covenants that attempt to preserve unrealistic anti-dilution ratchets or disruptive operational board voting vetoes. Our framework ensures your cap table remains perfectly clean, streamlined, and highly attractive for subsequent Series A lead term sheet negotiations.</p></div></div></section><section class="card undefined mb-lg bg-zinc-900 border-2 border-line p-6 text-center"><div class="doclabel mb-1">§ 04 — OPEN REFERENCE RESOURCE</div><h3 class="card-title text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">Download Standard India FAST Term Sheet (.PDF)</h3><p class="undefined text-sm text-muted max-w-xl mx-auto mb-6">Access our open-source, non-binding reference template containing explicit vesting schedules (2-year vesting with a standard 6-month cliff), IP assignment schedules, and statutory corporate Indian definitions.</p><div class="stack-h justify-center gap-4 flex-wrap"><a class="btn btn-primary undefined stack-h align-center gap-2" href="/startups/services/equity"><svg width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 12h6m-6 4h6m2 5H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"></path></svg>View Model Clauses Online</a><a class="btn btn-outline" href="/blog/equity-for-services">Read Equity Engineering Deep-Dive →</a></div></section><section class="mb-lg"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 05 — LEGAL KNOWLEDGE BASE</div><h2 class="section-title mb-4">Founder Term Sheet FAQ</h2><div class="measure"><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqList"><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-0"><span>Why does DBERT prefer advisory shares (FAST) over early priced equity rounds?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-0" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Executing a formal priced equity valuation or shareholder formalization across Indian corporate legal jurisdictions (MCA/FDI compliance) can consume months of costly operational overhead. Founder Advisor Standard Template (FAST) agreements simply execute a milestone-driven advisory grant that instantly aligns engineering deliverables without complicating your early capitalization table or holding up ongoing engineering sprint velocity.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-1"><span>What happens to the assigned intellectual property (IP) if engineering milestones are missed?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-1" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Our standardized legal contracts contain strict milestone-gated equity tranches. Every individual sprint deliverable (e.g., custom RAG pipeline deployment, vector indexing optimization, UI/UX client release) must formally pass rigorous integration criteria on your Git repository before the associated equity tranche vests. If milestones remain unfulfilled, zero equity vests and you retain complete legal rights to all contributed codebase commits up to that point.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>Are DBERT term sheets legally compliant with Indian Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) guidelines?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Yes. Our reference frameworks are adapted specifically for Indian entities incorporated under the Companies Act (2013), seamlessly integrating with official Udyam/MSME recognition parameters, standard shareholder agreement (SHA) protection clauses, and statutory sweat equity or ESOP pool allocations.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>Can we alter or modify these reference term sheet clauses with our corporate legal counsel?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Absolutely. We actively encourage founders to review every section of our standardized open-source templates alongside independent corporate legal advisors. Our aim is total transparency and mutual execution speed, not rigid or predatory contractual entrapment.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-4"><span>How does this equity model interact with subsequent institutional VC funding rounds?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-4" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>DBERT advisory equity grants act as lightweight common or advisory allocations that sit alongside standard founder equity. When you transition into formal Seed or Series A financing rounds led by institutional venture funds (such as Y Combinator, Peak XV, or Blume Ventures), our equity simply converts or dilutes alongside founding shareholders according to standard industry pro-rata practices.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-5"><span>Is there any retrospective cash financial obligation if our enterprise pivots or shuts down?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-5" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Never. We act as genuine engineering co-builders who intentionally share venture execution risk alongside you. If your startup undergoes a commercial pivot or ultimately ceases operations, the granted equity simply dissolves without any retrospective cash clawback or financial indebtedness for technical sprints performed.</p></div></div></div></div></section><div class="card bg-card p-8 rounded-lg border border-line text-center"><div class="doclabel mb-1">§ 06 — INITIALIZE COLLABORATION</div><h2 class="card-title text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">Ready to Build With Aligned Technical Leadership?</h2><p class="text-sm text-muted max-w-lg mx-auto mb-6">Submit your pitch deck and architecture summary today.
