Serving open-weights models (such as Llama-3 and Qwen) locally via vLLM or Ollama inside an isolated VPC guarantees total mathematical privacy and fixed, predictable infrastructure costs.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-1"><span>Which cloud GPU platforms and instance configurations do you deploy for incubated startups?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-1" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We deploy multi-cloud compute architecture across AWS EC2 (G4dn, G5, and P4 instances), GCP, RunPod bare-metal GPU nodes, and Lambda Labs. By automating dynamic node scaling and spot-instance redundancy, we reduce computational operational costs by up to 60% compared to default cloud provider setups.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>How do you structure high-performance vector databases for enterprise RAG retrieval?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We build hardened PostgreSQL database clusters equipped with the pgvector extension. We configure specialized indexing algorithms—including Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) and Inverted File Flat (IVFFlat)—to guarantee sub-100ms semantic search queries even across multi-million document embedding vector stores.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>How do you protect private model runtimes from distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>All backend model serving endpoints reside behind strict Nginx reverse proxies configured with rate-limiting token buckets, IP filtering, and SSL TLS termination. External requests never communicate directly with bare-metal GPU inference ports.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-4"><span>Is continuous infrastructure health monitoring and database backup management included?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-4" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Yes. Every enterprise infrastructure build incorporates automated daily automated encrypted snapshot backups for PostgreSQL vector volumes, alongside real-time Prometheus and Grafana alerting dashboards tracking VRAM consumption, token generation throughput, and error rates.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="container pad-block border-t border-line"><div class="doclabel mb-2">§ 09 — RELATED INCUBATION SERVICES &amp; Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) are better suited for closely held bootstrapped professional service firms.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-1"><span>How long does the complete SPICe+ incorporation and DPIIT recognition timeline typically take?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-1" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Standard MCA SPICe+ entity incorporation—including Digital Signature Certificates (DSC), Director Identification Numbers (DIN), PAN, and GST allocation—typically completes within 7 to 10 working days. Subsequent DPIIT Startup India recognition completes within 2 to 3 weeks upon submission of technical validation proofs.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-2"><span>What are the core income tax exemptions and capital benefits unlocked by DPIIT Startup India registration?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-2" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Recognized startups gain access to Section 80-IAC income tax exemptions for 3 consecutive years out of their initial 10 years, exemption from angel tax under Section 56(2)(viib), self-certification under labor laws, and fast-tracked patent application facilitation with up to an 80% government fee rebate.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-3"><span>How do your standardized agreements protect founder equity from early departed co-founders or developers?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-3" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>We deploy strict 4-year founder equity vesting schedules incorporating a mandatory 1-year cliff and robust Good Reason/Cause definitions. If a co-founder departs during the first 12 months, unvested equity is automatically absorbed back into the corporate equity reserve without disputational deadlock.</p></div></div><div class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqItem "><button type="button" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqQuestion" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-answer-4"><span>Do you provide specialized AI model legal terms and intellectual property assignment contracts?</span><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-chevron-down FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqArrow" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"></path></svg></button><div id="faq-answer-4" role="region" class="FAQAccordion-module__ivj6SG__faqAnswer"><p>Yes.
